# tests/fixtures — provenance index

Per `docs/oss/50-data-and-fixtures/provenance-policy.md`, every fixture
directory carries documented source / license / retrieval-date / SHA-256
metadata. This file is the index; per-subdirectory READMEs hold the
columnar tables.

## Layout

```
tests/fixtures/
├── cuad-sample/         ← 5 contracts + golden JSONL (CC-BY-4.0 from CUAD v1)
├── multi_domain/        ← 26 hand-curated text slices + 24 hand-labeled gold files
├── download_fixtures.sh ← Project Gutenberg downloader (untracked outputs)
├── download_hf_fixtures.py ← HuggingFace dataset downloader (untracked outputs)
└── .gitignore           ← excludes downloader outputs; whitelists the two corpora
```

## Tracked subdirectories — see per-dir README

| Directory | Files | License | README |
|---|---|---|---|
| [cuad-sample/](cuad-sample/README.md) | 5 contracts + 1 golden JSONL + DATA_LICENSES.md + MANIFEST.json | CC-BY-4.0 (CUAD v1) | [cuad-sample/README.md](cuad-sample/README.md) |
| [multi_domain/](multi_domain/README.md) | 26 `*.txt` + 24 `*.gold.jsonl` + 1 calibration_results.json | Mixed (per-file table; texts public-domain or permissive, gold labels Apache-2.0) | [multi_domain/README.md](multi_domain/README.md) |

## Untracked downloader outputs

These files are excluded by `.gitignore` and regenerated by the
downloader scripts. They are too large to ship inside the wheel/sdist
and the downloaders are reproducible. Provenance still recorded here so
contributors know where they come from.

| File | Source | License | Downloader |
|---|---|---|---|
| `war_and_peace.txt` | <https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/2600/pg2600.txt> (Project Gutenberg #2600) | Public domain (US, ≥70 yrs after author's death) | `./download_fixtures.sh` |
| `shakespeare.txt` | <https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/100/pg100.txt> (Project Gutenberg #100) | Public domain (US) | `./download_fixtures.sh` |
| `usc.jsonl` | HuggingFace `alea-institute/kl3m-data-usc` (US Code, federal statutes) | Public domain (17 USC §105 — US federal government work) | `./download_hf_fixtures.py` |
| `edgar_agreements.jsonl` | HuggingFace `alea-institute/kl3m-data-edgar-agreements` (SEC EDGAR public filings, sample of 200) | Public record (SEC filings) | `./download_hf_fixtures.py` |
| `patents.jsonl` | HuggingFace `alea-institute/kl3m-data-patents` (USPTO patents, sample of 200) | Public domain (US Government work) | `./download_hf_fixtures.py` |

## Forbidden content

Nothing in this directory is sourced from a 273V customer engagement,
non-public Slack/email, or attorney-client-privileged material. See the
top-level provenance policy for the full forbidden-content list.

## Re-computing SHA-256s

```bash
# every tracked fixture in one go
git ls-files tests/fixtures/ | xargs sha256sum
```

If a SHA in this README or the per-dir tables drifts, either the upstream
content moved (re-record with `Retrieved` updated) or the file was edited
in-place (don't — keep fixtures pinned).
